run_visualization_demo_on_image: run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize panoptic, semantic, or instance segmentation on a single image
run_visualization_demo_on_video: run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize segmentation results on each frame of a video
create_async_predictor: create an AsyncPredictor to run Detectron2 model predictions asynchronously across multiple GPUs
use_async_predictor_put_get: use AsyncPredictor put and get methods to enqueue images and retrieve predictions in order
review_async_predictor_shutdown: review the AsyncPredictor shutdown method that sends stop tokens to all worker processes
